text.p: Techdyne Inc Monday said it completed the acquisition of private Lytton Inc for a combination of cash and stock, increasing annualized revenues to about $40 million from $24.1 million.

Lytton, an electronics manufacturer in Dayton, Ohio, posted net income of $620,000 on sales of about $16 million last year, Techdyne said. Techdyne posted a $743,00 net on revenues of $24.1 million in 1996.

A Techdyne spokesman said the company paid $2.5 million in cash, 300,000 shares of Techdyne ($10.5 million based on Monday's price of $3.50 a share) and additional compensation based on achieving certain sales targets over the next three years.
Shares of the manufacturer of precision electro-mechanical and electronic components traded at 3-1/2 Monday afternoon, up 1/16, but close to their 52-week low of 3-1/4.
